empty.published: Nothing published yet. Start with a new post.
empty.draft: No drafts. Save a post to drafts to finish it later.

confirm.body: “{{title}}” will be removed. This cannot be undone.

detail.immediate: Published as soon as it was ready

error.network: The connection to the platform failed.
error.rate_limited: The platform is limiting requests. Try later.
error.token_rejected: The platform refused the account’s access. Try again; if it repeats, reconnect the account.
error.scope_missing: The account is missing a permission. Reconnect it and allow everything it asks for.
error.misconfigured: The app’s connection to the platform is misconfigured.
error.invalid: The platform rejected the post’s settings.
error.file_rejected: The platform could not accept this video file.
error.media_missing: The uploaded video is no longer on the server.
error.unconfirmed: The platform did not confirm the post. Check it there before publishing again.
